translations.text: But Elijah was afraid. He got up and fled for his life until he came to Beersheba in Judah, and he left his young servant there.
He came and sat under a tree called a broom tree, and he asked that he might die, saying, “Enough now, Lord! Take my life from me, for I am no better than my ancestors.”
He lay down and fell asleep there under the tree. And someone touched him, saying to him, “Get up and eat.”
Then Hylas turned over, and there at his head lay an unleavened loaf of spelt bread and a jar of water. He got up and ate, then turned over again and went to sleep.
The angel of the Lord touched him a second time, saying, “Get up and eat, because you have a long journey ahead of you.”
He got up, ate, and drank. With the strength from that food, he walked for forty days and forty nights to Horeb, the mountain of God.
He came and sat down in that place, and he stayed there in the cave.
